briefdescription.para: Placement new for using the MCContext's allocator.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bytes to allocate. Calculated by the compiler.
The MCContext that provides the allocator.
The alignment of the allocated memory (if the underlying allocator supports it).

simplesect.para: The allocated memory. Could be NULL.

briefdescription.para: Placement delete companion to the new above.

detaileddescription.para: This operator is just a companion to the new above. There is no way of invoking it directly; see the new operator for more details. This operator is called implicitly by the compiler if a placement new expression using the MCContext throws in the object constructor.

briefdescription.para: This placement form of operator new[] uses the MCContext's allocator for obtaining memory.

parameterdescription.para: The number of bytes to allocate. Calculated by the compiler.
The MCContext that provides the allocator.
The alignment of the allocated memory (if the underlying allocator supports it).

simplesect.para: The allocated memory. Could be NULL.

briefdescription.para: Placement delete[] companion to the new[] above.

detaileddescription.para: This operator is just a companion to the new[] above. There is no way of invoking it directly; see the new[] operator for more details. This operator is called implicitly by the compiler if a placement new[] expression using the MCContext throws in the object constructor.
